{{Quote|&hellip;Chad Longko...|General Mohc calls Chad Longko to receive an award|<ref name="SftE" />}}
'''Chad Longko''' was a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who trained as a [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|of Carida]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. Longko joined the academy<ref name="SftE" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]],<ref name="Reader Date 1">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', and by extension the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio adaption]], at a date of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The text mentions that the cadets graduating have spent four years at the academy. Using simple math, it can be deduced that Chad Longko joined the academy at a date of [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].</ref> and graduated<ref name="SftE" /> during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Reader Date 2">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', and by extension the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio adaption]], at a date of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> The graduation ceremony for that year's cadets was overseen by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]], who called Longko's name, alongside several others, to step forward and receive a special award of valor and merit.<ref name="SftE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chad Longko was first mentioned in the [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|audio adaption]] of the novella ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', which was released in [[1997]]. As the character's name is only given in spoken dialogue from the audio adaption, the actual spelling of the character's name cannot be determined.
